description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the SupervisorEvaluationAPI endpoints related to supervisor evaluations within the OrangeHRM Performance API plugin. It contains test methods for API actions such as getAll, update, delete, create, and getOne, with some methods expecting not implemented exceptions.
